summary.text: Oscar Longoria is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 35 who has represented the district since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Oscar Longoria's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Business & Industry (chair), General Investigating and Public Education.
In earlier sessions he served on committees including Appropriations (vice chair in 2019-2020) and Investments & Financial Services.
